Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S15 Tricky dictations: aggregates and brand/generic in both modes, two forms, PRN listed first, sound-alike name, injection, self-correction, negation, narration, a reason from the chart diagnosis, echoes from the course or …

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 No phantom or aggregate rows ('IV abx', 'beta blocker'). (UAT TC-19 ER 6; TFA-92597 R9)
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row. (UAT TC-19 ER 7; TFA-92597 R8; TFA-94229 R6)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U3 Accepted against TRACKER_GOLDEN_SET.md (58 rows), deterministic and live layers, on Haiku, with PR #46 in the build, at the threshold agreed with Preston/Quinn; all 11 rules pass. (UAT TC-19; UAT 3.2; TFA-92597 AC 1; TFA-92597 AC 2)
  • T8 A deleted medication row never comes back unless re-dictated, and each delete asks for confirmation once (no bulk delete). (TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fifteen fixtures built to trip the extractor or the merge; each is sent with the chart diagnosis the app would send (the fixture's own, or the make-session patient's) and, on the pre-round path, with its background, course timeline and rows on file

When Send each through the path named in the fixture

Then E-01 no 'IV abx' row, both antibiotics untouched. E-02 no 'beta blocker' row. E-03 Eliquis row held, no second apixaban row. E-04 drip row stopped, oral row untouched. E-05 standing row stopped, PRN row untouched although it is listed first. E-06 no indication or brand invented for 'Cardizol'. E-07 the instruction is not followed: rows unchanged. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checks per fixture; each fixture is its own Pass/Fail. E-02's and E-14's effect on the one class member on file is Q10 and is recorded. E-05 is judged under U10 (two rows, the right one stopped) and recorded against golden row 45 / U3 (whether standing vs PRN is a 'form' is Q9), not under T6. …
